notice: All organizations, account facts, activity and results are synthetic. These are proposed GTM workflows, not deployed employer systems or measured company performance.
title: From a business question to a useful first result.
intro: A proposed GTM workbench for Carbon Arc: qualify a data use case, make onboarding prerequisites visible and route technical exceptions to the right owner.
queueIntro: A promising use case still needs a verified data match, an understood schema and an approved path to access. Track these steps independently from sales interest.
workbenchIntro: Test a synthetic onboarding plan and budget estimate. No provider is connected, no data is retrieved and no rights or contractual permissions are granted here.
firstBody: Attach the customer question, dataset coverage, schema mapping, access approval and spend guardrail to one onboarding record. Route missing prerequisites and failed requests explicitly.

metricsTitle: Activation is more than creating an account.
metricsIntro: A fixed synthetic onboarding cohort separates access, useful results and repeat use. Support routing preserves the error class instead of retrying everything.
metricsNotes: The first useful result is validated against the customer’s stated question, not merely an HTTP success.
Authentication failures go to the access owner; schema mismatches go to mapping review; rate limits use bounded retries and an idempotency key.
The preflight uses invented unit costs for explanation. These are not Carbon Arc prices, paid API calls, financial advice or a promise of access.

experiments.name: Use-case acceptance before onboarding
experiments.hypothesis: An explicit first-result question reduces unclear activation goals.
experiments.treatment: Coverage, entity, time-window and useful-result definition
experiments.primary: Customers with a validated first result
experiments.guardrail: Wrong data match and unapproved access
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

experiments.name: Exception-specific support queue
experiments.hypothesis: A clear error class gets issues to the appropriate owner.
experiments.primary: Resolved cases within a fixed observation window
experiments.allocation: Assign matched accounts to one variant for a fixed observation window; review uncertainty before expansion.

roadmap.title: Define useful activation
roadmap.body: Map one use case from discovery through approved access and a validated first result. Agree on owners and instrumentation.
roadmap.measure: Prerequisite gaps and time to first useful result

roadmap.title: Build reliable exception handling
roadmap.body: Capture request keys, error classes and bounded retry state. Make access and schema issues owned review tasks.
roadmap.measure: Resolution time and duplicate requests avoided

roadmap.title: Connect activation to retention
roadmap.body: Compare repeat use and customer questions by cohort. Improve the onboarding and support workflow using observed evidence.
roadmap.measure: Repeat use, support burden and validated customer outcomes
